_comment: Curated leaderboard references for tdcommons datasets. PRECEDENCE per dataset: (1) POLARIS HUB (the TDC ADMET Benchmark Group, which Polaris mirrors; preferred over TDC's own leaderboard, which can contain errors); (2) MoleculeNet, where the dataset is the same as a MoleculeNet benchmark (hiv, clintox); (3) a single reputable/recent paper ('provider': 'literature') for datasets on no leaderboard at all. 'provider' records which of these each score came from. IMPORTANT: 'literature' entries are best-effort REFERENCES from individual papers on THAT paper's own split/metric (recorded in 'split'/'source') — they are NOT comparable to one another, to the Polaris numbers, or to eosbench's baseline. Datasets still blank have no clean dataset-specific number (the Butkiewicz HTS panel is reported as logAUC, not ROC-AUC; SARS-CoV-2, PAMPA, skin_reaction, carcinogens have no comparable AUROC). Keyed by tdcommons dataset slug.

hiv.source: Wu et al. 2018 (MoleculeNet), best model; same dataset as TDC HIV

clintox.source: Wu et al. 2018 (MoleculeNet), best model (2-task avg); same dataset as TDC ClinTox

b3db_classification.source: B3DB / B3clf best model (Meng et al., Sci. Data 2021)

herg_karim.source: recent ML benchmarks on the Karim et al. 2021 hERG set (~0.94-0.96)

hlm.source: Li et al., Chem. Res. Toxicol. 2022 (NCATS HLM/RLM ML), test set

rlm.source: Li et al., Chem. Res. Toxicol. 2022 (NCATS HLM/RLM ML), test set

cyp2c9_veith.source: MapLight + GNN, Polaris TDC ADMET leaderboard

cyp2d6_veith.source: MapLight + GNN, Polaris TDC ADMET leaderboard
